correctness.rationale: For fixed positive a,d,K the conserved K=BD/C reduces the full flow exactly to a canonical two-variable convex Hamiltonian F=e^p+e^q+e^(p+q)/K-dp-aq. Hessian determinant is e^(p+q)+K^(-1)e^(p+q)(e^p+e^q)>0 and F is proper, yielding one critical point and simple closed positive levels. Original time obeys T(E)=A'(E) by coarea. E-scaled sublevel sets converge in bounded support to the negative-quadrant triangle of area 1/(2ad), while Brunn–Minkowski concavity of sqrt(A) justifies differentiating the area asymptotic; therefore T(E)/E→1/(ad). On the lower q branch with -dp/E in [δ,1-δ], q=-(E+dp)/a+o(1) and dot p=-a+o(1); its flight consumes limiting proportion 1-2δ, yielding uniform joint scaled negative-log samples after δ↓0. Independent SymPy verified Casimir, Hamiltonian equations, Hessian algebra; not a numerical proof of E→∞.
